objective: Extract a shared helper across three crates with verifier output

discover.prompt: Read the three crates and identify the duplicated logic. Name the helper, target module, and the shape it should take.

design_review.purpose: Approve the extraction shape before edits

human_gate.prompt: Approve the proposed helper signature and target module before edits land.

extract.purpose: Land the helper and the three call-site replacements
extract.prompt: Create the helper in the target module. Replace the three duplicated sites. Run `cargo check --workspace` after each crate to fail fast.

compact_now.purpose: Compact mid-refactor before the verifier step
